messages:
anya: Opening a compact refresh PR for the HelloDock quickstart focused on Go + Private auth clarity. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4231. Need review of the Go snippet and the KMS flow wording.

samir: Nice. For the Go sample, prefer idiomatic client usage and a tiny helper for token exchange rather than raw HTTP.

miriam: Keep examples short (<=30 lines). Add a "Do not commit secrets" callout and a one-liner about rotating tokens.

jonah: CI note: our example compile step expects the SDK import to be pinned. Use v0.1.3 in the snippet so the smoke job passes, or add a mock for CI. I'll push a CI-friendly tweak.

anya: I'll pin to v0.1.3 and include a comment in the snippet saying to upgrade to latest in real projects. Also adding a tiny Dockerfile single-stage and a note about correct ownership of /root/.redwood to avoid permission failures in containers.

link-bot: link-checker: outdated link -> /deploy/private/setup (404). Suggest /private/deploy/setup. Commented on PR.

samir: Also make local dev vs Private clear: local uses personal API keys env var REDWOOD_API_KEY; Private uses KMS-signed tokens exchanged server-side. Add a mini table to illustrate.

miriam: A11y: ensure copy buttons have aria-labels and the copy-confirmation uses role="status". I'll add the microcopy.

ci-bot: CI: smoke run queued for PR #4231. Status: lint -> passing, go-compile -> pending, e2e -> pending. Will post results here.

anya: Thanks all  pushing edits now, will ping when CI is green. Please drop inline comments on the KMS wording if anything reads too dense.
